stem:
Hakeem received 13 phone calls on Tuesday. This expression can be used to show the number of phone calls he received on Saturday.

13 \times 4

Which statement is true?

options.label: F
options.text: Hakeem received 4 more phone calls on Saturday than he received on Tuesday.

options.label: G
options.text: Hakeem received 4 more phone calls on Tuesday than he received on Saturday.

options.label: H
options.text: Hakeem received 4 times as many phone calls on Saturday as he received on Tuesday.

options.label: J
options.text: Hakeem received 4 times as many phone calls on Tuesday as he received on Saturday.

difficulty_rationale: The problem requires understanding of multiplication and interpreting it in context with a straightforward comparison of quantities related to phone calls on different days.
